d:
a small, round, peach-shaped Pokémon with a pale peach-colored body and a purple, shell-like exterior. It possesses two small, purple, horn-like protrusions on its head and a singular, small, purple tail. It has two small, pale peach arms with three claws on each hand. The eyes are small, black, and circular with a focused expression.
BODY COLOR: pale peach
